validation: Current register-oichi-v27.py build(..., allow_partial=True) passed native dimensions, alpha, all source hashes, component isolation, hand occupancy, occluder regions, frame uniqueness and schema requirements.
visual_review: Inspected all eight full-draft 230px overlay sheets and all eight independent 148px full-bow overlays.
Bow grips and drawn strings align with the intended palms; right-hand draw metadata is only present during draw phases.
Guard and dash bash use awase bow curved centerline alignment through both rigid fists, without string-draw metadata.
Charged slam angles were adjusted to keep visible bow tips above the ground plane.
Planted roots were refined to visible outsole baselines. Air archery frames1–5 use virtual roots below the airborne feet.
One shared anatomical ruler is used per sheet; rulers were selected from skull/neck, torso and unfolded leg segments, not alpha bounding boxes.
uncertainty: Hand positions and rectangles are manually estimated, approximately 5–12 source pixels depending on occlusion/open fingers.
Rigid two-hand alignment is optimized for bow_awase_yumi; other catalog bows have different limb curves and may show small second-hand offsets.
The fixed preview canvas clips upper bow tips at 230px, while 148px previews retain full bows. This is a preview viewport limitation rather than cropped source art.
